covenants.name: consolidated secured leverage ratio
covenants.waiver_or_amendment_note: Amended via Fourth Amendment to 5.50:1.00 for quarter ending September 30, 2025 and thereafter (was 5.00:1.00 for quarter ended June 30, 2025)
covenants.quote: Following the Fourth Amendment, the Company’s maximum consolidated secured leverage ratio under the Credit Agreement was 5.00:1.00 until June 30, 2025 and is 5.50:1.00 for the quarter ending September 30, 2025 and thereafter.

covenants.name: consolidated leverage ratio
covenants.quote: Pursuant to the Credit Agreement, the Company’s maximum consolidated leverage ratio is 6.00:1.00 and, through June 30, 2025, its minimum interest coverage ratio was 2.50:1.00.

covenants.name: consolidated interest coverage ratio
covenants.waiver_or_amendment_note: Amended via Fourth Amendment to 2.00:1.00 for quarter ending September 30, 2025 and thereafter (was 2.50:1.00 through June 30, 2025)
covenants.quote: the Company’s minimum consolidated interest coverage ratio was amended to be 2.00:1.00 for the quarter ending September 30, 2025 and thereafter

covenants.name: minimum Consolidated EBITDA
covenants.waiver_or_amendment_note: Added via Fourth Amendment; also requires $52,000 for cumulative two quarters ending September 30, 2025 and December 31, 2025
covenants.quote: Pursuant to the Fourth Amendment, (x) the Company’s maximum consolidated secured leverage ratio was amended to be 5.00:1.00 for the quarter ending June 30, 2025 and 5.50:1.00 for the quarter ending September 30, 2025 and thereafter, (y) the Company’s minimum consolidated interest coverage ratio was amended to be 2.00:1.00 for the quarter ending September 30, 2025 and thereafter and (z) a covenant was added requiring the Company to maintain a minimum Consolidated EBITDA (as such term is defined in the Credit Agreement as amended by the Fourth Amendment) of (i) $17,000 for the quarter ending September 30, 2025 and (ii) $52,000 for the cumulative two quarters ending September 30, 2025 and on December 31, 2025.
